title: Little Bethlehem
old_p1: Micah was a prophet, a man who speaks for Heavenly Father. He lived long before Jesus was born.
Micah said, “Bethlehem, though thou be little…” Bethlehem was a small town on the hills, with sheep fields nearby.
Micah said a ruler, a king who leads his people, would come from little Bethlehem. Micah was talking about Jesus!
old_p2: Many, many years later, wise men came looking for the new King. The teachers in Jerusalem knew Micah’s words. They said, “In Bethlehem!” And that is just where Jesus was born.
Little things can be great to Heavenly Father, and so can little you! Tonight, hold up one little finger and think of baby Jesus.
p1: Long before Jesus was born, Micah told the people what Heavenly Father said. He told them a great King would come one day.
Micah did not name a big, busy city. He said, “Bethlehem, though thou be little.” Bethlehem was a small town on the hills, with sheep fields nearby.
Out of little Bethlehem would come a ruler to lead Heavenly Father’s people. Micah was talking about Jesus!
p2: Many years later, wise men came to Jerusalem looking for the new King. The teachers there remembered Micah’s words. They said, “In Bethlehem!” And that is just where Jesus was born.
Little things can be great to Heavenly Father, and so can little you! Tonight, hold up one little finger and think of baby Jesus.
